description: Kerala Budget 2026-27: CM V D Satheesan announces a Rs 50 crore Gen-Z startup fund, Malayalam AI initiative, healthcare expansion and major investment plans despite fiscal challenges.
body_lead: Addressing the media here after a Cabinet meeting on Wednesday, Satheesan termed the former Governor's unilateral communication to President Droupadi Murmu a major procedural and constitutional lapse. Kerala has announced a major technology and startup push, including a dedicated Rs 50 crore fund for Gen-Z entrepreneurs and a first-of-its-kind Malayalam Artificial Intelligence initiative, as Chief Minister VD Satheesan presented the revised State Budget for 2026-27 on Friday.
